html:
Here is a shot of the globular cluster M3 taken on the night of March 17-18, 2008 around 12:30. It is a stack of 20 photos of 30 sec at ISO 800 with 40 darks and 15 flats. Stacking in Nebulosity under Mac OS X.5
Camera: Canon EOS Rebel xti
Lens: AF Nikkor ED 80-200 F2.8 D at F2.8. The lens is coupled to the Canon body via an adapter.
Site: Grand-Mère
Mount: approximate equatorial (this is my first equatorial alignment and I couldn't see Polaris)
The moon was about 20 degrees to the west.
